evals.prompt: I have a shell script utility at `deb-packager/evals/files/sys-cleanup.sh`. Please package it into a Debian .deb package named `sys-cleanup` with version `1.0.0`. It depends on bash and coreutils. When installed, users should be able to run `sys-cleanup` directly from terminal.
evals.expected_output: A valid sys-cleanup_1.0.0_all.deb package with correct DEBIAN/control, proper dependencies, an executable /usr/bin/sys-cleanup launcher, and no unwanted GUI .desktop file.
expectations: Produces a valid Debian package named sys-cleanup_1.0.0_all.deb
DEBIAN/control specifies Package: sys-cleanup, Version: 1.0.0, Architecture: all, and Depends containing bash and coreutils
Contains /usr/bin/sys-cleanup with executable permissions (-rwxr-xr-x) and root/root ownership
Does NOT pollute /usr/share/applications/ with a .desktop file for this CLI utility

evals.prompt: I have a Python project at `deb-packager/evals/files/weather_cli`. Package it into a Debian .deb package named `weather-cli` version `1.2.0`. Use an isolated virtualenv installed to /opt/weather-cli/venv and provide a terminal launcher at /usr/bin/weather-cli.
evals.expected_output: A valid weather-cli_1.2.0_<arch>.deb package bundling a relocated /opt/weather-cli/venv virtual environment and /usr/bin/weather-cli entrypoint wrapper, plus a reusable weather-cli.recipe.json recording prepare_cmd and runtime_cmd.
expectations: Produces a valid Debian package for weather-cli version 1.2.0
Bundles the isolated virtual environment under /opt/weather-cli/venv/
Scripts inside /opt/weather-cli/venv/bin/ have relocated shebangs pointing to /opt/weather-cli/venv/bin/python3 instead of temporary build paths
